label: Stay criteria (hard blocker, gate, routing) reduce to one property: always-loaded force; rule files load on trigger and sit at level 3 of the precedence ladder

Must-stay set: 18 row-groups across sections 1-7 (Four Laws, PLAN-WORKFLOW LOCK, Comment Hygiene, Halt Conditions, Gates 1-5, Confidence Thresholds, Skill Routing Reference, Consolidated Question Protocol, Final-State Verification, Completion Verification Rule, Memory Save Rule, Self-Check list, Logic-Sync, Escalation), delta 0 each

All 8 true gaps are movable; real AGENTS.md line savings are only 4 lines (two 3-line rows: two registers L140-142, violation recovery L124-126); six 1-line rows net zero because the pointer occupies the freed line
Move-down is a doctrine-capacity operation, not a size reduction: 1-line rows buy expansion headroom on the rule-file side; line-count-only reading would wrongly conclude nothing is worth moving

Violation Recovery is the weakest candidate: its trigger (gates skipped) is when the agent is least likely to consult a trigger-loaded rule file; adjacency to the gates carries its force; lean keep unless RQ4 warrants a gate-discipline file
Cross-window rows (L315 git push, L483 never fabricate, L491 dispatch rules, L497 close-out) are already expanded and correctly keep their binding one-liners; no move-down needed
Unifying rule: expand-or-point - doctrine moves down into rule files, the binding one-line statement stays always-loaded; the 8 gaps are the incomplete tail of this already-executed pattern
Only one of the 8 gaps lives outside section 3 (Violation Recovery); sections 4 and 7 are saturated
The 8 gaps form 4 adjacent pairs sharing hosts (L161-163, L179-180, L188-190); moves should be section-additions to 3-4 existing files, not new files
L491 dispatch rules is delegation-and-orchestration.md's only AGENTS.md anchor; moving or subtracting that file touches an always-loaded row
No row above the 8 gaps should leave the always-loaded surface; the must-stay layer is the deliberately irreducible binding layer, not trimmable bloat
